bridge.sentence: Jul 2026: Profit +€70k but cash +€212k — customers reduced their outstanding balance by €34k, collecting more than was invoiced; €34k more paid to suppliers than newly invoiced; VAT of €120k paid to tax authority; €240k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Aug 2026: Profit +€47k but cash €97k — customers owed €202k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €48k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €128k paid to tax authority; €117k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Sep 2026: Profit +€48k but cash +€158k — customers owed €229k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €76k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €107k paid to tax authority; quarterly tax advance of €40k paid; €390k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Oct 2026 (forecast): Profit +€40k but cash €93k — customers owed €143k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €47k more paid to suppliers than newly invoiced; VAT of €80k paid to tax authority; €116k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Nov 2026 (forecast): Profit +€55k but cash +€27k — customers reduced their outstanding balance by €327k, collecting more than was invoiced; €353k more paid to suppliers than newly invoiced; VAT of €96k paid to tax authority; €74k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Dec 2026 (forecast): Profit €39k but cash +€138k — customers owed €417k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €270k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €123k paid to tax authority; quarterly tax advance of €40k paid; €466k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).
